items.title: Coinbase Global (COIN) Opens Bitcoin Backed Mortgages To Qualified US Homebuyers
items.summary: Coinbase Global (NasdaqGS:COIN) and mortgage lender Better have launched general availability of Bitcoin-backed mortgages for US homebuyers. The product combines conforming Fannie Mae first-lien mortgages with crypto-secured second liens backed by Bitcoin held on Coinbase. The offering follows an initial waitlist phase and is now open broadly to qualified US buyers, with incentives tied to Coinbase One membership. This move shows how crypto and housing finance are starting to intersect...
